entities.name: Drone
entities.rationale: Drone icon drawn at left of the dashed vertical line, above the 3rd party computer; flown by third-party pilots to capture well pad imagery. Located in the external/third-party zone left of the dashed divider.

entities.name: 3rd Party Software
entities.rationale: Computer icon labeled '3rd Party' (AWS_Icon_3) left of the dashed divider; third-party image processing software/server that stores the processed imagery (orthomosaic, DTM, DEM). Grouped with the drone in the external zone.

entities.name: CloudWatch Event
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'CLOUDWATCH EVENT' (AWS_Icon_4); scheduled CloudWatch Event (EventBridge rule) that triggers the Step Function. Right of the dashed divider, in the AWS zone.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Pink icon labeled 'STEP FUNCTIONS' (AWS_Icon_2); workflow orchestrating three Lambda functions. In the AWS zone.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'LAMBDA' (AWS_Icon_1); represents the three Lambda functions (check for new flights via API, copy images to S3, create raster proxy) invoked by Step Functions. In the AWS zone.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_7); stores the drone image files in Marathon Oil's environment. In the AWS zone.

entities.name: Storage Gateway
entities.rationale: Green icon labeled 'STORAGE GATEWAY' (AWS_Icon_6); lets on-prem mapping software read the image files from S3. In the AWS zone, next to S3.

entities.name: On-Prem Mapping Server
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'SERVER' (AWS_Icon_5) drawn INSIDE the white rectangular box on the right, which represents the on-premises environment; hosts the on-prem mapping software. Contained in the same box as the Database.

entities.name: On-Prem Database
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'DATABASE' drawn INSIDE the white rectangular on-premises box, below the Server; the local server's database where raster proxies are stored. Contained in the same box as the Server.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow on the left from the drone down to the 3rd party computer: drone imagery is loaded into the third-party processing software.
Green arrow from the top of CloudWatch Event curving to Step Functions: scheduled event triggers the step function.
Arrow from Step Functions curving down to Lambda: the step function invokes the three Lambda functions.
Long green arrow from Lambda curving along the bottom to the left, labeled 'API', pointing to the 3rd party zone: first Lambda calls the third-party API to check for new flights/images.
Arc drawn over the top from the drone/3rd party area to S3: images are copied from the third party into the S3 bucket (performed by the second Lambda).
Line from Lambda up to the area below S3 with an arrowhead at S3: Lambda stores images in S3 / reads S3 images to create the raster proxy.

Green line from the S3/Lambda area running to the Database in the on-prem box, with arrowheads at both ends: third Lambda creates raster proxies from S3 images and stores them in the local server's database.
Arrow from the top of the on-prem box (Server) up to Storage Gateway: mapping software accesses images through Storage Gateway.
Short arrow from Storage Gateway pointing left to S3: Storage Gateway retrieves the image files from the S3 bucket.
